name: Blackmailing The Family
source:
The protagonist unearths dirty secrets of the members of his family and begins to blackmail them. He also finds a big secret about his family's history. At the same time, he doesn't limit the blackmail to just the family. There are his teacher and principal as well. His plans are to open a porn film company and use any means to get people to take part in his films.​
